card.name: Currency and banknote issuance text
card.fires_on: Words in passages about money, currency and banknotes, such as 'currency' in 'currency of denomination', 'issued' for a coin, or 'Reserve' in 'Federal Reserve Note'. It also fires on linking words and punctuation inside these passages.

modes.label: Currency role phrases
modes.description: Words in economics text about a currency's role in bond markets or as money.
modes.example: focusing on its role as<< currency>> of denomination in global bond markets.

modes.label: Banknote issuance and design
modes.description: Words and digits in text about notes being printed, redesigned or put into circulation.
modes.example: Notes continued to<< be>> improved, with the design placed into circulation

modes.label: Properties of money
modes.description: Commas and 'and' in lists of what makes something money.
modes.example: it has to be durable, divisible<<,>> portable and widely accepted.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about redeeming, issuing and pegging currency, mostly Chinese and English terms like 兑换, redemption and issuance.
card.plain: It lights up in passages about money and banknotes being issued, and prepares words like redeem, peg or issuance.
